event_name: Time 14:45 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 Appendix 1, Part B of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations for this Event, specifies that Mr Mika Salo shall be one of the FIA Stewards. In accordance with Article 11.9.3.n of the FIA International Sporting Code, Mr Salo is substituted by Mr Michael Masi, the holder of an FIA Super licence, for Thursday 25th October 2018 only.
title: Doc 5 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Stewards Information Change Of Steward
